budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town sent Senator Tran six capital project requests, with the Turkey Hill item most likely to be funded.
budget_items.quote: it included $25,000 for the eagle house hvac system for the older section of the building

budget_items.topic: Paramedic service start-up costs per ambulance
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Initial start-up costs for paramedic status were estimated at $40,409 per ambulance.
budget_items.quote: initial start up costs would be $1573 for medications and a refrigerator to store them

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ongoing paramedic costs were estimated at about $15,500 a year.
budget_items.quote: ongoing costs would be for medical control fees ($7,000/yr), equipment maintenance ($3,500/ yr)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Anticipated revenue increases from paramedic status were estimated at $131,085 based on current ambulance rates.
budget_items.quote: anticipated revenue increases would be around $131,085 for various services if the town had paramedic status.

budget_items.topic: Paramedic savings from on-call stipend and staffing
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Potential savings of $26,000 on the on-call stipend were noted, and about $151,584.57 would be realized once fully staffed.
budget_items.quote: some potential savings would be $26,000 for the current on call stipend

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Training costs were estimated at $12,000-$15,000 for paramedic school and $1,500 for advanced school, with up to $15,000 a year proposed for training.
budget_items.quote: we could train our own and allocate training money; $12,000-$15,000 for paramedic school (12-24
